title: Among all cards illustrated by artists who have also designed cards with no
question: Among all cards illustrated by artists who have also designed cards with non-powerful foils (i.e., missing either cardKingdomId or cardKingdomFoilId), what percentage of those cards that are legal in the 'commander' format do not have a content warning?

prediction.sql:
WITH non_powerful_foil_artists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_002 AS artist
    FROM cards
    WHERE XCL_007 IS NULL OR XCL_006 IS NULL
),
commander_legal_cards AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_064
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
      AND c.XCL_002 IN (SELECT artist FROM non_powerful_foil_artists)
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_064 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(XCL_001)
FROM commander_legal_cards
